scripts.render:hero: bunx remotion still src/index.ts hero-screenshot --output out/hero-screenshot.png
scripts.render:demo: bunx remotion render src/index.ts demo-video --output out/demo-video.mp4
scripts.render:gifs: bunx remotion render src/index.ts gif-event-explorer --codec gif --output out/gif-event-explorer.gif && bunx remotion render src/index.ts gif-live-stream --codec gif --output out/gif-live-stream.gif && bunx remotion render src/index.ts gif-api-key --codec gif --output out/gif-api-key.gif && bunx remotion render src/index.ts gif-onboarding --codec gif --output out/gif-onboarding.gif
scripts.render:all: bun run render:hero && bun run render:demo && bun run render:gifs
